title: Only 1 reason for not a 5 star!
body:
This is my first review! Cause I literally never write reviews… but this app is amazing, I absolutely LOVE the chime sound, as I tick off things off my to do list. There is only one problem: you can’t add due dates for sub-tasks. There are some tasks which are not important enough to be a task, and are a sub task of a task, however they need to be done by a due date to reach the overall due date for the main task. It really bothers me to not have a due date for sub tasks! Please please include that! 

Other than that, amazing app— love the minimalistic design and the chime.
